an7.84:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattime bhikkhave, adhikaraṇasamatha dhammā uppannuppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāya.
an7.84:1.3: sammukhā vinayo dātabbo, sativinayo dātabbo, amūḷhavinayo dātabbo, paṭiññāta karaṇaṃ dātabbaṃ, yebhuyyasikā dātabbā, tassapāpiyyasikā dātabbā, tiṇavatthārako dātabbo.
an7.84:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave, satta adhikaraṇasamathā dhammā uppannuppannānaṃ adhikaraṇānaṃ samathāya vūpasamāyāti.
